tool_input.description: Check double arithmetic for resize indent calculation

result:
Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/cli/help/TextHelpAppendableAgentTest.java` with 35 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering:

- `indexOfWrap` boundary/error cases (width ≤ 0, no-whitespace chop, break chars, `Integer.MAX_VALUE` overflow handling)
- Constructor defaults, getters/setters, and the live `TextStyle.Builder` view
- `appendHeader`/`appendTitle`/`appendParagraph` no-op-on-empty behavior, invalid level errors, and exact wrapped/underlined output
- `printWrapped` (both overloads)
- `appendList` no-op, ordered/unordered formatting
- `makeColumnQueue`/`makeColumnQueues` wrapping and padding
- `writeColumnQueues` padding of exhausted columns
- `adjustTableFormat` and `appendTable` (including caption handling)
- `resize` including min-width clamping and the `maxWidth == 1` indent-zeroing edge case
- Inherited `append` passthrough

All 35 tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
